positive.prompt: Add German and Japanese translations to our React app
Prices show a dollar sign for every country, format currency for the user's locale
Support Arabic with right-to-left layout in our Vue app
Replace the hard-coded English strings in these components with translation keys

evals.prompt: Do the task described in TASK.md.
evals.expected_output: Cart summary strings moved to translation keys in en, de, and ar with locale plural rules, currency formatted with Intl using the cart's currency, dir=rtl for Arabic with logical CSS, and tests across locales
expectations: All user-facing text in the cart summary, including the aria-label, comes from translation keys present in en.json, de.json, and ar.json
Item-count wording uses locale plural rules (for example Intl.PluralRules or ICU plural categories) rather than count === 1, and Arabic has its additional plural categories
The total is formatted with Intl.NumberFormat (or an equivalent locale formatter) using the locale and cart.currency, with no hard-coded $ or toFixed
The Arabic rendering sets dir="rtl" and lang, and the component's left-specific styles are replaced with logical equivalents such as text-align: start and padding-inline-start
Tests assert the rendered output in at least en and de including currency formatting, Arabic direction, and plural forms for more than one count
The full suite is run with npm test after the change and passes
